daily.name: alibaba/open-code-review
daily.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
candidate_sources: https://github.com/trending?since=daily
daily.summary_zh: 一个 AI 代码审查命令行工具，源自阿里巴巴内部使用多年的代码审查助手。配置好模型接口后，它会读取 Git 变更，把改动的文件交给大模型分析，并生成精确到代码行的审查意见；分析时它还能查看完整文件、搜索代码库、参考其他改动文件，因此能给出比只看 diff 更深入的审查。
